Name: Super Santa Slayer
Overview:
It's an ultimate showdown between Santa and RoboSanta. Defeat the Grunch, Snowman, a other characters as you work your way to face the Ultimate Boss.

Battle your friends in 2 player mode to prove who is the true king of Krismas fighting is.

Will you make it to the top or will you be Santalitized?

Featuring an all 8 bit soundtrack and vintage style old school graphics.
